_note: Wrong programs that the grader used to accept, each paired with how it is now caught. Test data: tests/content.test.mjs compiles every one. Not served to the page.

cpp-function-default-power.why: power is declared with two required parameters and main passes 2 by hand, so there is no default argument anywhere in the program
the default is 1 rather than 2, and main passes 2 explicitly, so every printed line is right and power(base) is not

cpp-reference-accumulate.why: addAll SETS the total instead of adding to it, and main hides that by adding the two sub-totals together itself
addAll accumulates into a 32-bit local before adding it on, which every existing case was too small to notice

cpp-combine-word-report.why: summarise prints the report itself and never writes to its reference parameters; main calls it and prints nothing
there is no isLetter function: the two character ranges are written out inline, so nothing can call it
summarise adds to letters instead of setting it, which is invisible while the caller always starts it at zero

cpp-function-digit-sum.why: there is no digitSum function; the loop is inline in main for the fourth time, which is the one thing the exercise asks you not to do
digitSum takes its parameter by reference and destroys the caller’s variable; main happens to keep its own copy, so nothing shows

cpp-function-gcd-lcm.why: Euclid’s loop is inline in main and there is no gcd function, so lcm cannot be three lines that call it

cpp-function-perfect-numbers.why: both functions are gone and main is two nested loops, so the three layers the exercise is about do not exist
divisorSum counts n itself among its divisors, and isPerfect compensates by comparing against twice n, so the printed list is right

cpp-reference-min-max.why: extremes prints the two lines itself and leaves lowest and highest as the caller set them

cpp-reference-swap.why: swapInts takes its parameters by value and swaps two copies; main swaps its own variables by hand afterwards

cpp-vector-above-mean.why: the running total is an int, which overflows at the sizes the constraints allow — no case reached them until now
